does: A method of ecl::animation::GameplaySystem: appends the id of the ASAnimation event to the entity's list in the map at +0x178 of the system, then sends the event to the entity's blueprint through the animation blueprint system kept at +0x18.

evidence.says: It finds or adds the entity's array in the map at +0x178, pushes the id global of ASAnimation and calls TriggerGameplayEvent<EoCGE::ASAnimation> with the pointer at +0x18; the macOS ecl::ASAnimation::Update has the same steps inline.
A probe while Osi.PlayAnimation runs on the host shows 1 call, from bg3_dx11.exe@25605617+0x1BC3C2B inside ecl::ASAnimation::Update.

questions.ask: What reads the list at +0x178: is it how the system knows which finished event to hand back to the action state?
